summary:
iter-330b Sinus Lift Continue-button dead-end follow-up. Backend regression: 17/17 PASS (test_sinus_lift.py 10/10, test_preop_briefing.py 7/7). Code review confirmed both iter-330b changes are correctly in place: (a) /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/new-procedure.tsx lines 901-914 — handleContinueToImplants now builds sectionDetail = [{label, fields}] from FLOW_STEP_LABELS + flowStepMissing, and renders body as '• <Section>
   - <Field 1>
   - <Field 2>' joined with '

' between sections. The format exactly matches what the user requested. (b) lines 1316-1337 — for the non-existing-implant branch (fresh Sinus Lift / Immediate / PET / GBR / Guided Surgery cases) the validator now pushes 'Number of Implants' into missImplantDetails when formData.num_implants is empty AND the procedure type is in PROCEDURES_WITH_NUM_IMPLANTS_QUESTION. Previously this gate only ran inside the Existing-Implant branch (lines 1311-1322), which is why a fresh Sinus Lift case could leave num_implants blank, see Prosthetic Plan dropdown stay hidden (gated by getProstheticOptions returning [] when num_implants is empty), and end up perpetually blocked. The fix surfaces 'Number of Implants' AND 'Prosthetic Plan' in the popup explicitly. Frontend E2E click-through: I logged in as Gaurav.pandey/Student@123, soft-navigated to /new-procedure (Phase 1 - Diagnosis and Treatment Planning, Step 1 of 5). Verified the Continue button renders with data-testid='continue-to-implants' and shows the helper text 'N sections still incomplete — tap to see what's missing' (visible in screenshot when initially landing on Step 4 Phase 1 Checklist tab). However I could not capture the RN-Web Alert.alert popup body verbatim end-to-end via Playwright because (i) Alert.alert on Expo/RN Web renders an in-app modal — NOT a native browser dialog — so page.on('dialog') never fires; (ii) the 5-tab paginated form (Case Details / Treatment Plan / Clinical Exam / Phase 1 / Submit) requires navigating between pills, and the pill text uses non-deterministic ellipsis ('4. Phase 1 …') that conflicts with the page title 'Phase 1 - Diagnosis and Treatment Planning'; (iii) my click on the Continue button via data-testid was sometimes intercepted by the bottom-nav 'New Case' tab on the same screen, navigating the user back to Step 1. The popup-format verification is therefore based on code review at lines 901-914 — the format is provably '• ${label}
   - ${fields.join("
   - ")}'. Action item for main agent: a 30-second manual test (fill case details, pick Sinus Lift, leave num_implants blank, walk to Phase 1 tab, tap the locked Continue button) will visually confirm the popup body now includes 'Number of Implants' and 'Prosthetic Plan' under Treatment Plan.
action_items: Quick 30-second manual confirmation: pick Sinus Lift as procedure type, do NOT set Number of Implants, tap Continue to Implant Selection — popup body MUST now contain '• Treatment Plan' followed by indented '- Number of Implants' and '- Prosthetic Plan'. This is the iter-330b enriched format the testing agent could not capture verbatim through Playwright (RN-Web in-app Alert modal not capturable via page.on('dialog')).

Lines 901-914 of new-procedure.tsx: popup body construction is clean — `sectionDetail.map(s => '• ${s.label}${s.fields.length ? 
   - ${s.fields.join(
   - )} : ""}'.join('

')` — produces exactly the user-requested format with indented sub-bullets per missing field.

Lines 1316-1337: num_implants and prosthetic_plan now both surface for the fresh Sinus Lift / Immediate / PET / GBR / Guided Surgery flow — closes the root cause where the user filled Treatment Plan but the validator silently demanded prosthetic_plan, which itself cannot render until num_implants is picked.

Lines 1342-1347: Sinus-Lift-specific extras (Type of Sinus Lift, Bone Graft Material, invalid tooth list) already surfaced in the missing-fields panel — these correctly co-render under the same 'Treatment Plan' bullet thanks to the field-name array.

Minor: line 1321 still has the legacy `else if (FULL_ARCH_GROUP...)` branch for the Existing-Implant flow; this is functionally correct because the prior `if (PROCEDURES_WITH_NUM_IMPLANTS...)` only push when present, so the FULL_ARCH validation still runs when num_implants is NOT applicable. No fix needed.

context_for_next_testing_agent: RN-Web Alert.alert popups do NOT fire page.on('dialog') in Playwright — they render as in-app Modal components. To capture popup text, search document.body.innerText for the title string ('Incomplete sections'). The new-procedure flow is a paginated single-page form with 5 tabs (Case Details / Treatment Plan / Clinical Exam / Phase 1 Checklist / Submit). The 'Continue to Implant Selection' button (data-testid='continue-to-implants') only renders inside the Phase 1 Checklist tab AND is visually-disabled (greyed + lock icon) until all 4 prior sections report green. The button's onPress always fires, even when locked. The page title is 'Phase 1 - Diagnosis and Treatment Planning' which conflicts with text-selector 'Phase 1' — use the pill label '4. Phase 1' with regex prefix '/^4\\./' instead. Bottom-nav 'New Case' tab is overlap-prone — scroll the button into the middle of the viewport before clicking. iter-330b's popup body format is implemented at lines 901-914 of /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/new-procedure.tsx and verified by code review.
rca of the issue:
iter-330 fixed the UI-render side (added 'Sinus Lift' to CLINICAL_EXAM_GROUP + NON_FULL_ARCH_TYPES). iter-330b addresses a SECOND, parallel root cause: for a fresh Sinus Lift case, the Prosthetic Plan dropdown is gated by `getProstheticOptions(num_implants)` which returns [] when num_implants is empty (because PROCEDURES_WITH_NUM_IMPLANTS_QUESTION includes Sinus Lift). The user fills 'Treatment Plan' visually but leaves num_implants empty → prosthetic_plan dropdown never renders → validator silently demands prosthetic_plan → 'Treatment Plan' section stays red → Continue button stays locked → popup says 'Treatment Plan' incomplete with no actionable hint. iter-330b fix: (1) line 1316-1337 explicitly push 'Number of Implants' AND retain the existing 'Prosthetic Plan' push so both surface side-by-side in the popup; (2) lines 901-914 enrich the popup body to list per-field detail under each section. Net effect: the popup now reads 'Please complete the following before continuing to Implant Selection:

• Treatment Plan
   - Number of Implants
   - Prosthetic Plan' instead of just '• Treatment Plan' — telling the user exactly what to fix.
